test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Kamalini and Nalini Asthana were conferred the Padma Shri in 2022 for which of the following?

options.text: For teaching and propagating Kathak globally
For taking Indian cuisine to the world
For disaster relief work in Gujarat
For specialising in the study of Indian society

solution:
The correct answer is __**For teaching and propagating Kathak globally **__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Kamalini Asthana and Nalini Asthana are a sister duo from Agra in Uttar Pradesh known for their great performances of the Banaras Gharana style of Kathak.
 
• They are also known for their contributions to the popularisation of the Benaras Gharana style of Kathak both in India and abroad.
 
• In 2022, Govt of India conferred the Padma Shri award, the third highest award in the Padma series of awards, on Kamalini Asthana and Nalini Asthana** for**** teaching and propagating Kathak globally.** 
 
• The award is in recognition of his service as an "Acclaimed Kathak Dancer Duo from Agra known for teaching and propagating it globally.
